name: erp-logistic
description: Last-mile delivery ERP for Lima Metropolitana and Callao

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:root && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.typecheck:web: if find apps/web/src \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) | grep -q .; then tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json; else echo '[typecheck] apps/web has no sources yet; web tsconfig deferred until the first web source exists'; fi
